title: kissed and springy mediterranean fiordilatte pizza
description: A buttery, springy, and romantic mediterranean dish featuring fiordilatte. Perfect for a low-carb dessert or snack
instructions: Spread a thin layer of extra-virgin olive oil on a baking sheet.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness and place on the baking sheet.
Spread the fiordilatte cheese evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomatoes, fresh basil, and fresh oregano over the cheese.
Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and top with fresh mozzarella cheese, if using.
Return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the mozzarella is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice into 8 equal pieces and serve immediately.
Note: If using a pizza stone, preheat the stone in the oven for 30 minutes before baking the pizza.
